reason.advertising: Advertising or a conflict of interest
reason.unverified_claim: An unverified accusation (such as about hygiene)

report.title: Report this recommendation
report.intro: Nobody can see who reported, neither the author nor the maintainers. When several members report it, the recommendation is hidden until a maintainer reviews it.
report.done: Your report was received. Thank you.

errors.already: You have reported this recommendation already.
errors.own: You cannot report your own recommendation.
errors.notFound: This recommendation is no longer there.
errors.generic: The report was not sent. Try again later.

author.maintainer: Only you and the maintainers see it, and it is not counted. You can still edit it; ask a maintainer if you have questions.
author.reports: Only you and the maintainers see it, and it is not counted. Nobody is told who reported it or how many did. After the review you get a notice: shown again, kept hidden, or deleted as a violation.

moderate.hideIntro: Once hidden, only its author and the maintainers see it; the author gets a notice and sees the reason.
moderate.unhideIntro: Members see it again; its open reports are resolved.
moderate.unhideMemberRemoved: Its author was removed from the circle with their recommendations hidden. Unhiding shows this recommendation to members again.
moderate.stillHidden: Its author was removed from the circle with their recommendations hidden, so it stays hidden (now as removed with its author). Unhide it once more to show it anyway.

errors.notFound: This recommendation is no longer there.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again later.

queue.intro: Recommendations with open reports, and every hidden recommendation. Nobody sees who reported, maintainers included.
queue.loadError: The review list could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
queue.label: Recommendations to review
queue.reviewReason: Why (required to delete; kept in the audit log only)
queue.deleteWarning: Deleting erases the recommendation's content and its revisions and cannot be undone. The author gets a notice; the reason is kept in the audit log only.
queue.revealHint: Every look is recorded in the audit log.

done.restoredStillHidden: Reports resolved; its author was removed from the circle, so it stays hidden.

errors.notUnderReview: This recommendation needs no review any more.
errors.notFound: This recommendation is no longer there.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again later.
